description: Ratchet baseline for `npm run ui:check`. Counts may only go down: when a rule's live count drops below its baseline, run `npm run ui:check -- --update-baseline` in the same change. Rules at 0 are hard-forbidden and must never ratchet up. Structure: rule id -> { count, note?, files? }.

raw-color.note: Stock from the pre-P3 monolith; P3 (motion/chart/dark wiring) reduces it in parallel. Ratchet down after each merge.

raw-z-index.note: 73 CSS declarations plus ColumnFilter.tsx zIndex literals (FA-06); migrate to the var(--z-*) ladder.

raw-font-size.note: Stock outside the type scale; migrate to var(--text-xs..2xl).

raw-shadow.note: Stock outside var(--shadow-1..3)/var(--ring); migrate to elevation tokens.

ease-keyword.note: Bare ease keywords eliminated by P3 motion tokenization (FA-09). Keep at zero.

window-confirm.note: Hard-forbidden since 2026-08-13 (zeroed in P1); never ratchet up.

hand-rolled-backdrop.note: Hard-forbidden since 2026-08-13 (zeroed in P1); never ratchet up.

english-chrome.note: Hard-forbidden since 2026-08-13 (zeroed in P2); never ratchet up.
